native_metric_protocol.name: UniAD-v2.0-style open-loop planning
native_metric_protocol.time_aggregation: cumulative mean of first 2/4/6 positions at 1/2/3 seconds
native_metric_protocol.collision: native fixed axis-aligned 4.084 x 1.85 m raster rectangle with +0.5 m forward offset
native_metric_protocol.GT_self_collision: native per-timestep exclusion of predicted collision where GT collides; denominator remains all eligible scenes
native_metric_protocol.L2: native masked Euclidean XY distance, complete six-keyframe population
native_metric_protocol.grid: native 200 x 200, +/-50 m, 0.5 m; distinct from auxiliary grid
native_metric_protocol.out_of_range: native metric preserves its clipping behavior; all scenes also receive explicit out-of-range diagnostics
native_metric_protocol.ego_state: legal previous/current sensor poses provided identically
native_metric_protocol.obstacles: original UniAD only_vehicle=True: cars, buses, trucks, trailers, construction vehicles, bicycles, motorcycles; filter_invisible=False

protocol.origin: current LiDAR origin with forward/left axes
protocol.navigation_source: original VAD global-sensor future endpoint +/-2 m, fixed high-level text only
protocol.ego_state: previous/current LiDAR poses only, displacement at nominal 0.5 s from actual past dt
protocol.body_geometry: original UniAD fixed 4.084 x 1.85 m rectangle, +0.5 m forward offset
protocol.sensor_timing: each current camera mapped via its timestamp ego pose to lidar-time ego(t0)
protocol.timing_protocol: six successive annotated 2 Hz keyframes, original VAD eligibility; jitter retained and reported
protocol.map_height_approximation: map planar yaw projection; label height evidence masks unsupported road levels
